step.citation: How far one owner grade moves a piece's running grade (on a scale of -1 to 1) or a register's target length (in words).

spread.unit: grade or words per owner grade
spread.citation: Small enough that one grade never decides a choice, large enough that a dozen grades in one direction do.

lengthWeight.citation: How much one word of distance from a register's target length counts against a piece, against its running grade.

spread.citation: A piece five words off its register's target loses about half a running-grade point at the middle value.
